notes.title: Fury and Fun
notes.content:
Hey Leaf Blowing Legends!

We're back with another taste of the exciting update we're working on for Master Leaf Blower! Get ready for even more hilarious chaos coming your way.

This time, we're giving you a glimpse of two new additions that will surely add a fresh gust of fun to your leaf-clearing adventures.

First up, watch out for this friendly face!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195785/da9e48bad9876be01c71c96fb151e5792df0368c.png[/img]
It seems not everyone appreciates your dedication to pristine pavements. Better keep an eye on your surroundings – some neighbors might take matters into their own hands (and pitchforks!).

But it's not all angry mobs! We're also adding a touch of artistic appreciation to the city. Feast your eyes on this upcoming mural with a little bit of cinematic inspiration, Master Leaf Blower style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195785/f9132dfe6b9e85c174383b69fd05213f217cb775.png[/img]
Stay tuned for more updates on the development progress. We can't wait to share all the new features and craziness with you soon!

Keep blowing!

The Master Leaf Blower Team

notes.title: Springtime Saucers
notes.content:
The sun is shining, the flowers are smelling funny, and the spring update for Master Leaf Blower, a crazy simulation game, is just around the corner!

A picture is worth a thousand words, and in our physics-based crazy simulation, you'll once again step into the shoes of our hero and face all sorts of craziness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195785/307efafecf5f02c092d7b4e81272300a00bc44cd.png[/img]
Follow us, play Master Leaf Blower, or blow it onto your wishlist!

notes.title: Petrol Power Unleashed
notes.content:
Leaf warriors, did you think you had conquered the streets of Constant Fall with the electric buzz? You were mistaken!

The Holy Grail of all Leafblowers is here! We're unleashing petrol power, a beautifully smelly, sputtering, choking, and gloriously unreliable... PETROL LEAF BLOWER! ⛽️🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195785/24c1531ef57fc2b126002ebe9bf81c6326726fcc.jpg[/img]
It's roaring into the game as part of our spring content update, and we promise on a mountain of moldy mulch that it'll be a golden pain in the... dandelion patch! 🌼

Don't wait for spring to spring! Dive into Master Leaf Blower right now!

notes.title: Blown Away by Your Reviews!
notes.content:
Dear Leaf Masters and Madness Enthusiasts!

Wow, what a ride! Your positive reviews and support blew us away! Thanks to you, this wild adventure of a leafy revolution bursts with even more humor and energy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195785/9bdce16f2a1adab60d15a09e1ed6be2e89956a78.jpg[/img]

In our off-the-wall leaf blower simulator, every leaf, duck, paper, and all other stuff you send flying sparks an epic battle against the chaos of everyday life. You’ve experienced firsthand that absurd challenges, unexpected twists, and mind-blowingly hilarious moments are our signature style. When you step into the world of Master Leaf Blower, gear up for a crazy gameplay experience packed with comedic game elements, innovative mechanics, and unpredictable turns that make every second unforgettable!

We sincerely thank you for every "Wow!" and every glowing review that gives us wings (and blowers)! We’re beyond grateful to be building a community united by a passion for the extraordinary, and absurd, and this is just the beginning of our adventure! Get ready for more! In the upcoming updates!

Hold on tight, more outrageously crazy-blowing adventures are on the horizon!

With leafy regards,
Frix

notes.title: Master found his hands!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this is Frix, the developer of Master Leaf Blower, the leaf blower game! I want to send a huge thank you for all the support and love you've shown while playing this arcade physics game. Your excitement and enjoyment fuel my motivation to keep working on updates and making the game even better to become the best physics-based arcade games for casual players and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195785/dc0dd972f6b14741d9b41f8020f84d564caf59ae.png[/img]

In the latest update, the electric blower finally got its own hands! Big thanks to the talented 3D artist DJMaesen for creating the beautiful blower-hand asset with work gloves.

I'm also excited to share that my colleague Zayl, a graphic artist with whom I previously worked on Hobo: Tough Life, who previously created the model for the electric blower, has now finished a stunning model for a gas-powered blower! You can look forward to seeing it in a future major update, which will also bring new items, new locations, and animated hands for other tools like the rake, alien gun, and more.

I'm carefully listening to your feedback and working on customizable controls and graphics settings to give you more control over your experience to create relaxing and funny simulation with dynamic challenges.

Thanks again for your amazing support—I can't wait to share more adventures with you in my comic book-style indie game with unique mechanics: Master Leaf Blower! 🚀🍃

notes.title: Party with Elon fix
notes.content: Party with Elon fix, after finishing the level and pressing 'Enter,' the mouse look no longer moves the camera. The cursor should be visible so the player can continue and end the level normally.

notes.title: Early Access Released Today!
notes.content:
Hello dear fans, today we’ve released our long-awaited Early Access! Thanks to you, we’ve made it this far, and we’re ready to continue improving and fine-tuning the game based on your amazing player feedback. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to sharing this incredible comic-style adventure with Master Leaf Blower together with you!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195785/601a5684195a3b28506945ca65bb76da675785eb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Second Demo Update
notes.content: Based on your update, the camera FOV has been set higher and the crosshair size increased

notes.title: Demo update based on your feedback
notes.content: We are building this game together! Your feedback helps us constantly improve the gameplay experience. That's why we have boosted the leaf blower's power in the demo. Thank you for being part of our community!

notes.title: DEMO COMING OUT SOON
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195785/c649fa57a6e8bb244b1e937ec2819613826a0f01.jpg[/img]
Try our free demo coming out on 10.10.2024. Early access will be available later this year. So check it out and be the hero of the city! In demo you can try 3 levels from diferent city quoters and one highway minigame level. Add to your Steam Wishlist now!
